900.2.10(730).explanation: Exception R 730 permits office and retail store uses on 1615 Dufferin St., and on several named addresses (49 Auburn Ave., parts of Hendrick Ave., Peterborough Ave. and Rushton Rd.) an older former City of Toronto by-law prevails instead of these zoning rules. If your lot is one of these addresses, the older by-law governs and we do not evaluate it; otherwise this exception does not change your lot.

900.2.10(296).explanation: Exception R 296 has no site-specific provisions. On a list of named addresses (on Callender St., Harvard Ave., Lukow Ter., MacDonell Ave., Wabash Ave., Pearson Ave., Sorauren Ave., Triller Ave. and Wright Ave.) an older City of Toronto by-law prevails. If your lot is one of these addresses, the older by-law governs and we do not evaluate it; otherwise this exception does not change your lot.

900.2.10(740).explanation: Exception R 740 has no site-specific provisions. On named addresses (1359 Dupont St., 1011 Lansdowne Ave., 730 St. Clarens Ave., 376 Margueretta St., 39 and 100 Pauline Ave., 1183 Dufferin Street) an older City of Toronto by-law prevails. If your lot is one of these addresses, the older by-law governs and we do not evaluate it; otherwise this exception does not change your lot.
